data.summary: Tested business logic vulnerabilities on OWASP Juice Shop at http://127.0.0.1:3010. Confirmed multiple IDOR vulnerabilities: GET /api/BasketItems exposes all users' basket items, DELETE/PUT/POST on /api/BasketItems operates without basket ownership checks (deleted item from admin's basket), /rest/basket/{id} reveals any user's basket contents, and /rest/basket/{bid}/coupon/{code} applies coupons to any basket. Found critical quantity manipulation flaw: negative quantities are accepted and result in negative order totals (submitted order with -1 qty of $5000 item produced totalPrice=-5000). Decimal quantities (0.5) are also stored. The /rest/track-order/{orderId} endpoint requires zero authentication, exposing order details (email, products, prices) to anyone. Coupon codes (WMNSDY*, ORANGE*) exist client-side but are date-gated campaigns; server-side coupons appear to use different codes. Order checkout processes without payment validation, allowing orders with manipulated totals.

candidates.title: IDOR - BasketItems API exposes all users' basket items
candidates.claim: Any authenticated user can read all basket items across all users by calling GET /api/BasketItems without ownership filtering.
candidates.poc_hint: GET /api/BasketItems with any valid JWT token. Returns basket items for BasketId 1 through 5 (admin and other users) - no ownership check.

candidates.title: IDOR - DELETE on BasketItems removes items from other users' baskets
candidates.claim: Authenticated user can DELETE basket items belonging to other users via direct ID reference. Deleted item 3 (Eggfruit Juice) from admin's basket (BasketId=1).
candidates.proof_excerpt: {"status":"success","data":{}} (after DELETE /api/BasketItems/3 which belonged to BasketId=1, confirmed by checking /rest/basket/1 which showed only 1 remaining product instead of 2)
candidates.poc_hint: 1) GET /api/BasketItems to find items in other baskets. 2) DELETE /api/BasketItems/{id} with any valid token. 3) Verify via GET /rest/basket/{BasketId} the item is removed.

candidates.title: IDOR - /rest/basket/{id} reveals any user's basket contents
candidates.claim: Any authenticated user can read the contents of any basket by providing its numeric ID. Successfully read basket 1 (admin) from user with BasketId=8.
candidates.poc_hint: GET /rest/basket/1 with any valid JWT token (even though our user has BasketId=8). Returns admin's basket with products.

candidates.title: Quantity Manipulation - Negative quantities accepted and processed in orders
candidates.claim: POST/PUT on BasketItems accepts negative quantity values, leading to negative order totals. Placed order with -1 qty of $5000 artwork producing totalPrice=-5000.
candidates.proof_excerpt: "orderConfirmation":"a8bf-dcc09b094d1b57eb" (followed by order-history showing {"totalPrice":-5000,"products":[{"quantity":-1,"name":"Best Juice Shop Salesman Artwork","price":5000,"total":-5000}]})
candidates.poc_hint: 1) POST /api/BasketItems with {"ProductId":42,"BasketId":8,"quantity":-1}. 2) POST /rest/basket/8/checkout. 3) GET /rest/order-history to see totalPrice=-5000.

candidates.title: Quantity Manipulation - Decimal quantities accepted
candidates.claim: POST on BasketItems accepts non-integer quantity values (0.5). Validation isInt only during checkout but storage allows decimals.
candidates.poc_hint: POST /api/BasketItems with {"ProductId":2,"BasketId":8,"quantity":0.5}. Returns success with stored decimal quantity.

candidates.title: Order Tracking Without Authentication - Information Disclosure
candidates.claim: The /rest/track-order endpoint returns full order details (email, products, prices) WITHOUT requiring any authentication token.
candidates.proof_excerpt: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3010/rest/track-order/a8bf-dcc09b094d1b57eb (no Authorization header) returned {"status":"success","data":[{"orderId":"a8bf-dcc09b094d1b57eb","email":"t*st*s*r123@t*st.c*m","totalPrice":-5000,"products":[{"quantity":-1,"name":"Best Juice Shop Salesman Artwork","price":5000,"total":-5000}]}]}
candidates.poc_hint: GET /rest/track-order/{orderId} without any Authorization header. Returns order details including masked email, products, prices.

candidates.title: IDOR - Coupon application to other users' baskets
candidates.claim: PUT endpoint for coupon application accepts any basket ID, allowing one user to apply/cancel coupons on other users' baskets.
candidates.proof_excerpt: PUT /rest/basket/1/coupon/WMNSDY2019 returned "Invalid coupon." (endpoint accessible on another user's basket - no authorization error)
candidates.poc_hint: PUT /rest/basket/1/coupon/TESTCODE with any valid JWT. The endpoint responds with coupon validation (not authorization error) confirming IDOR on coupon application.

facts.summary: JWT token for testuser123@test.com with BasketId=8
Successfully placed order with negative quantity resulting in totalPrice=-5000
Deleted item 3 from admin's basket (BasketId=1) via DELETE /api/BasketItems/3

deadends: Coupon codes were not found on server side - tested campaign codes (WMNSDY*, ORANGE*) and PATTERN* codes but all returned 'Invalid coupon'. Server-side coupon database not enumerable without admin access. The client-side coupon system validates date-gated campaigns before falling back to server verification.
Price manipulation via direct price parameter in BasketItems POST (trying to override product price) not tested - server uses product lookup pricing rather than client-supplied price.
